referenceText: I can now use the slash delegate command to hand off the implementation. Korus sets up the worktree, starts the agent, and hands over the instructions.

voices.title: Calm American
voices.direction: A calm adult male voice with a warm lower-mid pitch, clear neutral American English accent, and relaxed confidence. Sound like a software engineer demonstrating his own workflow to a colleague. Brisk and fluent, around 180 words per minute. Clean dry solo speech, no music or sound effects.
